python.ok:
grep -E '^Udp' /proc/net/snmp; grep -E '^Udp6' /proc/net/snmp6 2>/dev/null
[ -r /proc/net/softnet_stat ] && { s=0; while read -r _ d _; do s=$((s + 0x$d)); done < /proc/net/softnet_stat; echo "softnet_dropped: $s"; }
dev=$(ip -o route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.* dev \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p')
for way in rx tx; do n=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$dev/statistics/${way}_dropped" 2>/dev/null) && echo "${way}_drops: $n"; done
n=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$dev/statistics/rx_missed_errors" 2>/dev/null) && echo "rx_missed: $n"
ethtool -S "$dev" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'allowance|drop|miss|err' || true
qdisc=$(tc -s qdisc show dev "$dev" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$qdisc" | awk '/^qdisc/ { root = / root/; if (root) seen = 1 } root && /dropped/ { n = $0; sub(/.*dropped /, "", n); sub(/,.*/, "", n); s += n } END { if (seen) print "qdisc_dropped: " s + 0 }'
echo "$qdisc" | sed 's/^/  tc: /'
for c in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]*; do [ -r "$c/thermal_throttle/core_throttle_count" ] && echo "$(cat "$c/topology/physical_package_id" 2>/dev/null):$(cat "$c/topology/core_id" 2>/dev/null) $(cat "$c/thermal_throttle/core_throttle_count") $(cat "$c/thermal_throttle/package_throttle_count" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"; done | awk '!seen[$1]++ { core += $2 } $3 > pkg { pkg = $3 } END { if (NR) { print "core_throttle: " core; print "package_throttle: " pkg + 0 } }'
awk '/^qdisc/ { root = / root/; if (root) seen = 1 } root && /dropped/ { n = $0; sub(/.*dropped /, "", n); sub(/,.*/, "", n); s += n } END { if (seen) print "qdisc_dropped: " s + 0 }'

uname -a; echo; lscpu 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo
cat /sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource 2>/dev/null
chronyc tracking 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo
sysctl net.core.rmem_max net.core.wmem_max 2>/dev/null
dev=$(ip -o route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.* dev \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p')
echo "dev $dev"; ip link show "$dev" 2>/dev/null
ethtool -i "$dev" 2>/dev/null; ethtool -k "$dev" 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'segmentation|receive-offload|scatter'

sudo -n systemctl stop apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer 2>/dev/null
sudo -n timeout 150 systemctl stop unattended-upgrades.service apt-daily.service apt-daily-upgrade.service 2>/dev/null
sudo -n snap refresh --hold=24h >/dev/null 2>&1
echo; echo "apt timers, unattended-upgrades: $(systemctl is-active apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer unattended-upgrades.service 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "snap: $(snap refresh --time 2>/dev/null | grep -i '^hold' || echo 'no hold')"
